title: Crypto B3 and US composite daily shadow function check
question: Can the fixed research rules accumulate daily shadow episode evidence with fixed capital and paired controls?

hashes.pending: Function-check inputs and code are hashed in each immutable daily ledger; operator seals confirmation inputs after feasibility.

features.name: original buy intent and daily open/close
features.available_at: intent timestamp and market session completion respectively
features.source: frozen research universe, normalized intent feed, Upbit/Yahoo public bars

labels.name: paired D_i crypto
labels.definition: net candidate minus control P&L divided by fixed E=3u at D0+60

labels.name: paired D_i US
labels.definition: net candidate minus control P&L divided by fixed E=1.5u at D0+20

period.pending: operator seals a separate confirmation epoch after the function check

test.exposure_audit: Function-check outputs are exposed and cannot become sealed confirmation data.
test.seal_rule: new manifest version and new ledger directory before confirmation

candidate_policies.description: 1u next-open hold to H=60 plus 2u cash
near-market next-open entry plus first -8% 50%-quantity add; E=1.5u
original frozen DAY limit, conservative open/close-only fill, no add; absent original limit is unverified

costs_fills.cost_table: research.strategy_evidence.common.ROUND_TRIP_COST; conservative full round-trip reserve per invested notional
fill_models: research: next open entry; closes for adds, targets and stops
US control: open <= original limit at open, otherwise close <= limit at limit, otherwise DAY unfilled; no intraday touch claim

metrics.primary: descriptive paired net P&L difference / fixed E at H

delta_min.pending: operator defines confirmation minimum effect; no efficacy or scale-up verdict in function check

stopping_rules: No broker, DB, credentials or order placement
Missing path-dependent bars suspend episode decisions and produce unverified results
Changed universe/rule/engine/cost hash requires new epoch
No statistical promotion from function-check evidence
